_comment: Week 1 workflow content. From docs/week1_spec.md. The weekly workflow engine (backend/weekly_workflow.py) reads this file and serves it through /api/weekly-workflow. Every step defines its type, display copy and completion rule — the engine never hard-codes copy. 'draft': true marks copy the team should replace before the flag flips to 'on'. 'video_id': null is the signal for the frontend to render a calm 'Video coming soon' card with Continue, so the flow never blocks on missing content.
title: Your first step
summary: A connected learning experience: see your starting point, pick a focus, make one small, specific plan.

overview_video.label: Overview video
overview_video.title: Why this matters now
overview_video.summary: A short intro to Life's Essential 8 and why nutrition during these years matters. The video ends by introducing your baseline recalls and the feedback you'll see next.

feedback.label: Your baseline feedback
feedback.title: Your baseline, in your words
feedback.intro: Based on the two days you recorded, here are areas where you're already close to the Dietary Guidelines, and areas with room to grow.
feedback.lead_in: Two days is an estimate, not a full picture. The next step is picking one area to try first.

focus_selection.label: Choose your focus area
focus_selection.title: Pick one area to work on
focus_selection.subtitle: You can change this after your next check-in. The other areas stay visible on Eat.

mini_lecture.label: Mini-lecture
mini_lecture.title: Learn more about your focus area
mini_lecture.summary: A short lecture on what your focus area includes, why it matters for your heart, and small ways to improve.
mini_lecture.coming_soon_body: Your mini-lecture is being finished. When it's ready, it will show up right here with captions. You can continue — the next step waits for your reflection, not a video.

reflection.label: Reflecting on your starting point
reflection.title: Reflecting on your starting point
reflection.intro_text: Here's how close your eating in this area is to the Dietary Guidelines. This is based on the two days you recorded.

prompts.label: Look at what's behind the result

variant_by_focus_kind.adequacy: Think about the two days you recorded. When did {focus} show up in your meals and snacks, if at all?
variant_by_focus_kind.moderation: Think about the two days you recorded. When did foods higher in {focus} show up in your meals, snacks, and drinks, if at all?

options: This isn't part of how I eat

prompts.label: Find the room to move
prompts.prompt: The space left on the bar shows where this area has room to grow. Where in your day could a small change fit most easily?

prompts.label: Notice what's working
prompts.prompt: What's one thing in your eating that's already working?
prompts.placeholder: A strength you'd like to keep

reflection.completion_message_template: Thanks. {occasion} is a good place to look. Next, you'll pick one small change and plan when you'll try it.
reflection.not_sure_yet_message: Thanks for reflecting. When you're ready to pick a spot, your focus area will help you narrow it down. Next, you'll pick one small change and plan when you'll try it.

goal_and_plan.label: Set your goal and plan
goal_and_plan.title: A small, specific goal
goal_and_plan.intro: Build on what you reflected on. Keep it small and specific.
goal_and_plan.goal_placeholder: A behavior you want to try, in your own words
goal_and_plan.plan_prompt: When / where will you try it?

fruit.goal: I will add fruit to breakfast on weekday mornings.
fruit.plan: When I prepare breakfast before class, I will add a banana or frozen berries.

vegetables_beans.goal: I will include a vegetable or beans at dinner on weeknights.
vegetables_beans.plan: When I plate dinner on weeknights, I will add a serving of vegetables first.

grains.goal: I will choose a whole-grain option at lunch when it's available.
grains.plan: When I pick a sandwich or wrap, I will choose whole-grain bread when it's offered.

dairy.goal: I will add dairy or a fortified alternative to breakfast.
dairy.plan: When I make breakfast, I will add yogurt or a glass of milk.

protein_foods.goal: I will include seafood, beans, or nuts in a meal twice a week.
protein_foods.plan: When I shop at the start of the week, I will pick up canned tuna or beans so one meal includes them.

fats.goal: I will swap one source of saturated fat for an unsaturated one each week.
fats.plan: When I cook with butter, I will try olive oil instead.

sodium.goal: I will choose a lower-sodium snack on busy afternoons.
sodium.plan: When I pack a snack, I will choose fresh fruit or unsalted nuts instead of chips.

added_sugars.goal: I will drink one fewer sugar-sweetened drink per day.
added_sugars.plan: When I'd normally buy a soda, I will choose water, sparkling water, or unsweetened tea instead.
